bugs.name: Numeric Between initial value accepts not-a-number and silently changes preview to a lone 50
bugs.summary: Numeric Between initial value accepts not-a-number and silently changes preview to a lone 50.

bugs.summary: Refreshing new-user success changes failed email invitation into a false “We sent an invite” confirmation.

bugs.name: Renaming a table while search is active leaves its old name in the filtered sidebar results

bugs.summary: CSV download from Admin dashboard embed preview silently fails.

bugs.name: Switching a new segment's table leaves Save enabled; clicking it silently disables Save without saving
bugs.summary: Switching a new segment's table leaves Save enabled; clicking it silently disables Save without saving.

bugs.summary: Add a map dialog retains previous map's preview and Refresh button despite empty inputs.

bugs.summary: Negative cron minute bypasses inline validation and gives a generic save error.

bugs.name: After previewing a dashboard in the embed wizard, a newly saved question shows that dashboard's collection in its breadcrumb
bugs.summary: After previewing a dashboard in the embed wizard, a newly saved question shows that dashboard's collection in its breadcrumb.

bugs.summary: Admin password reset leaves the user's existing sessions signed in.

bugs.name: PostgreSQL connection-string prefill joins query options with the wrong delimiter
bugs.summary: PostgreSQL connection-string prefill joins query options with the wrong delimiter.

bugs.summary: Deleted collection permission draft shows a Java null error on save.
bugs.expected: An understandable deleted-collection or out-of-date message rejects the obsolete draft.
